column2: Ailor
This character is an Ailor, a human forged by the order, ambition, and imperial doctrine of the Regalian Empire.
Teled
This character is a Teled elf, one of the ancient High Elves who bear the fading glory and burdens of the old world.
Isldar
This character is an Isldar elf, a frostbound soul entwined with cold cycles of death, rebirth, and remembrance.
Selvath
This character is a Selvath elf, a hardened survivalist shaped by relentless struggle, adaptation, and life in untamed wilds.
Eronidas
This character is an Eronidas, a warrior philosopher who tempers battle with art and reason.
Suvial
This character is a Suvial elf, trained to bind demons and wield the disciplined fury of flame.
Skyborn
This character is a Skyborn, an engineer descended from an ancient civilization driven by invention and lost technological wonders.
Asha
This character is an Asha, an animal folk inheritor of a fallen civilization whose echoes still shape their culture.
Allar
This character is an Allar, a learned lizard folk devoted to alchemy, scholarship, and the pursuit of refinement.
Dragonkin
This character is a Dragonkin, a half dragon inheritor shaped by ancient blood and desert legacy.
Sihai
This character is a Sihai, a sworn protector of the world rising from the depths of the Jade Sea.
Ruinborn
This character is a Ruinborn, a magic-warped elf born marked by unnatural skin tones and adaptive physiology.
Urlan
This character is a Urlan, a minotaur folk hunter known for quiet strength and gentle wisdom.
Dwarf
This character is a Dwarf, a deep delver hardened by stone, craft, and ancient tunnels.
Yanar
This character is a Yanar, an elusive plant like people defined by endurance and hidden traditions.
Slizzar
This character is a Slizzar, a serpentine shapeshifter skilled in spying and silent manipulation.
Maraya
This character is a Maraya, a vault dweller from another inheritor of ancient traditions and knowledge.
Bralona
This character is a Bralona, an inorganic being seeking identity, purpose, and self determination.
